args.prompt:
FRESH INDEPENDENT IMAGE JOB2,12KFB INTERNATIONAL LAWKEEPER SLOPS family. ONE landscape1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG3columns x2rows, EXACTLY SIX unique fictional order-enforcer ink monsters, whole isolated actors. BORDER/HARBOUR/INSPECTION/CEREMONIAL/TRANSIT/FUTURE authority archetypes. Tragically comic attempt to project authority, satirical power critique through pompous invented emblems/uniforms, disproportionate tools and insecure body acting. Not scenes of coercion, no victims or violence, no nation/ethnic facial stereotypes. Invented official-looking blank emblems only, no real insignia/flags or writing. Exactly TWO female-read slots1/6. No scenelets/full vehicles/desks. Same species material, but fresh acting distribution; no top-right O-mouth/bottom-right tongue, NO protruding tongues or circular O mouths.
Attached ORIGINALS are actual STYLE references only, NOT edit targets: image1 dark rich rounded footless ink-splat morphology/lids/lips/uneven ivory teeth; image2 lovely tactile handmade occupational props/cloth/brass craft. No copying uniform grin/glowing eyes. EVERY visible eye WHITE/IVORY sclera RED iris BLACK pupil. Whole continuous FOOTLESS charcoal-deep-violet plasticine ink splat with soft thick asymmetrical lobes, few droplets, fingerprints, subtle violet sheen and warm upper-left studio light. No human torso/legs/feet, faceted body/flat purple patches, generic cute animated-film face. Six different silhouettes/height/width/age/gaze/lids/mouth/body attitude BEFORE uniforms. Partial uniforms let ink dominate.1-2big readable beautiful clay props, simple bodily relation, not ornate riddles/clutter. Entire figures and every prop within own cell with EXTRA WIDE transparent gutters and generous safety margin, no crossings/touching/clipping.
TOP LEFT slot7 FEMALE-READ BORDER DOCUMENTS OFFICER: broad squat asymmetric ink splat, faded sea-green peaked cap and small plum collar, one thin gold shoulder braid. Sleepy half-lidded RED gaze down, CLOSED crooked smile with one flat gold fang. One goo hand grips a tiny blank passport booklet, other peers at it through a comically huge round brass magnifier so her OWN enlarged eyeball dominates glass. One round invented badge with raised simple concentric ring, no writing. Understated scrutiny turned self-scrutiny, no booth or border scenery.
TOP MIDDLE slot8 HARBOUR CONSTABLE: very tall thin slumped pear blob, navy knit officer cap with tiny plain brass anchor-shaped emblem, short faded cream scarf. Wide staring uneven WHITE/red/black eyes looking RIGHT, mouth pressed in a crooked ZIGZAG with three sparse ivory teeth. Both arms squeeze a huge worn cream life ring diagonally against own soft goo body, one fat brass whistle trapped awkwardly under ring. Ring tactile seams no text, no water/ship, no legs/bust.
TOP RIGHT slot9 GRAND CEREMONIAL PALACE GUARD: tiny low broad puddle under an absurdly huge tall red-and-brass ceremonial helmet with one soft olive plume, short navy collar and TWO oversized plain circular brass buttons. One eye tightly closed other looking UP red iris black pupil, huge crooked triangle UNDERBITE, not O. Both goo hands struggle to balance a chunky ceremonial mace held horizontally against belly, big rounded head with blunt bulbs, non-threatening stationary pose. Entire helmet/plume/mace fits cell. No aggressive attack/victims, no real monarchy/nation symbols.
BOTTOM LEFT slot10 MUNICIPAL HYGIENE INSPECTOR: medium tall bean-shaped ink blob, battered white official cap with tiny teal roundel, faded olive work collar. One eye half closed in suspicious concentration, other wide WHITE/red/black focused on an enormous brass caliper he uses to MEASURE a tiny single crumb held in opposite goo hand. Broad clenched flat ivory-tooth grimace. Two strong props only, no piles/desk/floating labels, bureaucratic obsession shown in physical size mismatch, beautiful metal and cream clay crumb.
BOTTOM MIDDLE slot11 TRANSIT FARE ENFORCER: spherical heavy drooping ink splat, small mustard peaked cap and short indigo collar, fat blank brass medallion. Very tired eyes red pupils LEFT, enormous downward lower-lip sag with two widely separated teeth, no smile/tongue. Cradles one thick mechanical turnstile COUNTER as a handheld rounded iron box with a single short three-spoke brass arm poking out, other hand holds tiny blank ticket pinched delicately. Entry authority without actual gate/scene, chunky stylized tool, whole goo body.
BOTTOM RIGHT slot12 FEMALE-READ RETRO-FUTURE ORDINANCE MARSHAL: tall asymmetric triangle-rounded ink splat with purple curled goo crest, small copper open helmet collar (face unobstructed), teal aviator hood and one brass shoulder tab. Confident broad SIDEWAYS jagged tooth smile, one lid raised and one sleepy WHITE/red/black eye, NO tongue. Holds a bulbous brass-and-cream portable permission scanner with big oval glass eye-lens pointing at a single tiny copper badge cradled in other hand: checking her OWN authority rather than anyone else. Badge plain rounded triangular spiral emblem, no letters. Worn gentle dieselpunk/retro-sci-fi, tactile clay glass, no weapon, no beams or graphics.
Authority critique remains tragicomic, fragile, theatrical and absurdly physical. Same KFB sculptural richness, no six identical grins/costume swaps. TRUE transparent alpha all empty areas/holes, no backdrop/gradient/floor/shadowdisc/environment/scenelet, no captions/words/numbers/logos/floating punctuation or real official emblems. EXACT SIX whole unique lawkeeper ink monsters3x2.
